cursor.note: /intent IS A LEARNING BLOCK — the first skill whose anatomy is a CALL rather than a paragraph about one, and the template brick the other eight copy. The seam (cairn/machines/skill_block/) reads each skill's input_contract FROM ITS OWN CHARTER, so migrating skill #2 is a charter edit with zero source change — pinned by a tooth that compares the seam's bytes across two tenants' firings. AKIEN'S RULING IS PHYSICS: a cast ticket with no intent_berth reds at BUILDME by name; 'none, because <why>' is the one other legal value and a BLANK one reds as an exemption, not as a bad path. Blast radius MEASURED, not assumed: 69 tickets, 24 red at their next BUILDME. THE LIVE FIRE EARNED ITS KEEP TWICE — it put a real finding at Akien's gate, and firing it with the berth root unwritable WEDGED /intent with a raw traceback, killing hypothesis (6) by its own falsifier; the shell door now splits the failure kinds (a wrong PACKET stays fatal, an unwritable ROOT is not), because the recording must never wedge the work. THE CENSUS GREW BECAUSE A GATE TOLD IT TO: this very crossing was refused at PROVEME because device_census could see no component under skills/ — its admission test was top-level *.py, which measures PYTHON, not componenthood. It is now charter-OR-py, a union so a charterless .py directory stays visible; measured before widening (same 23 rows under cairn/, 9 newly visible under skills/), 17th tooth beside it, orient re-sealed. That correction reached orient's registry without passing through Akien's hands at all — a gate he had already ratified did the catching. Two stale artifacts fell out on the way and were fixed at discovery, not filed: PROOF.md's cairnmap IOU, and cairn/machines/skill_block/ having no charter. The watch is ARMED and honestly unsatisfied: refusals=0, kills=0 against firings=1 — the door has never yet said no, which is exactly the vacuity question intent-door-refusals exists to answer.

window.note: PROVEN IN TWO PLACES BECAUSE THE MIGRATION HAS TWO HALVES. The seam (cairn/machines/skill_block/, 23 teeth) proves the machinery: contract read from the charter, every lack in one pass, the refusal traced so the denominator survives, a second tenant needing no code change, and the downstream consumer that refuses a BUILDME whose ticket names no /intent firing. This node's own proof (skills/intent/proofs/test_intent_skill.py, 8 teeth) proves the WIRE: the anatomy is a call the markdown fires and not a paragraph about one (the ticket's falsifier (3), measured as a grep because a skill's executor is an LLM reading markdown), SKILL.md and the charter's input_contract cannot drift apart, and the kill exit fires the same door as the forward one. Both green twice. TWO DEFECTS FOUND EN ROUTE, both by teeth authored to assert the opposite of what was true. (1) PROOF.md's IOU said cairnmap was unbuilt; it has been built and runnable, so this node's prove_gate had been discharged-in-principle and unnoticed for weeks - the tooth went red on its first run and the IOU is now an executable gate check. (2) That gate's first real run redded on cairn/machines/skill_block/ having NO CHARTER, which by CLAUDE.md means it does not run; the charter was written at the point of discovery rather than filed as a debt. A third, smaller: the gate teeth passed VACUOUSLY at first because the fixture handed ticket_path() the parent of CairnCommons instead of its sibling, so every fixture ticket read as unfiled and four teeth green'd on the silent path - fixed by composing ticket_path's own layout and pinned with a non-vacuity assert.

THE LIVE FIRE EARNED ITS KEEP AGAIN: firing the wire with the berth root unwritable WEDGED /intent with a raw PermissionError - hypothesis (6)'s falsifier, fired exactly as written. Fixed at the point of discovery rather than filed: the shell door now SPLITS the two failure kinds - a packet that fails the contract stays fatal (exit 2, every lack named), a root that cannot be written is not (exit 0, null berth, loud stderr, no traceback), because the recording must never wedge the work and the downstream BUILDME gate is what turns the missing berth into a refusal later. Charter amended, 24th tooth added, both resealed. THE MUTATION RUN ANSWERED ITS OWN FALSIFIER: stubbing the fire command out of SKILL.md reds the proof (exit 1, the anatomy tooth by name) and restoring it greens it - the teeth reach the WIRE, not just the machinery.
